visualReview.notes: Actually inspected all 90 final images: 23 portable, 23 shared, 44 medium-fi, after the roof support repair. Four complete turntables and dedicated whole views show the taper and separate open four-sided crown. Near samples show alternating curtain slopes, 600 mm glass fins, continuous chamfer recess returns, two service belts, full-height lobby diamonds, clear glazed canopies and four illustrative open-sector revolving drums. Top views show the centered schematic helipad, circle/H marking and gaps between roof platform and outer crown; slab and marking winding is upward. Added four steel supports connect the platform to the service-core roof, with independent ray tests, rather than leaving it unsupported. Thin fins and facade lines alias in far/portable views and their close back faces read pale through BLEND; no inspected principal wall, corner return or crown mass is missing. Exact drum height/positions and entry widths are reconstructed from photos.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Three canonical reusable graphs supply stainless metal frames/fin edges/canopies/crown, plain concrete slabs/platform and granite ground pads/lobby core. Opaque blue glazing, 52-percent clear lobby/fin/crown/door/canopy glazing and separate recess tint yield six near groups, with one BLEND group. Actual world-viewer frames show subdued silver metal, transparent fin/canopy panels and light granite ground contact. Original master retains four graphs including painted metal; current source/import/four derivatives embed zero images. Each shared graph is read once and viewer eviction disposes all live geometry. Skyline combines canonical surface means into one opaque draw; district uses four groups. Reference photography is not a runtime texture.

mediumFiReview.notes: Actually inspected all 44 current noon/late economy/high, feature, whole-level and transition views. Skyline keeps taper/chamfers, color service bands, simplified diamonds/canopy and open framed crown in one opaque draw, with flat crown members and opaque screens. District groups four floor intervals and retains coarse crown fins/framing. Street retains all working facade rows with coarser 10/7 fin spacing and 8 lobby diamonds per side; close has 36/32 fins and 18/16 diamonds, flat metal leading strips, finer canopy ribs and clear crown screens. Dedicated whole-level views show every complete level despite automatic context/silhouette cameras cropping the upper tower. Near diamond/crown/canopy detailing reads more clearly; fine strips and shadows alias. Crown and four-sided envelope persist across transitions; skyline crown looks more solid because of opaque screens. Synthetic cottage context and flat geographic ground do not certify Beijing terrain or adjacent site grade.

geographicReview.notes: Fresh exact Q2006129 way 116944490 independently confirms the individual 330 m/74-level China World Tower A rectangular footprint, unchanged from the cached 58.465 by 52.803 m ring within 0.002 m rounding. Retain anchor [116.45236545,39.91097545] and heading -1.568897708342: native +X north bearing 359.89 degrees, -Z east bearing 89.89 degrees for the hotel, and +Z west bearing 269.89 degrees for offices. SOM explicitly documents office entrance west and hotel entrance east, supplying the signed cardinal control that the rectangle alone lacks. Primary architect whole/base/fin/canopy photographs and facade-consultant pages 10/11 were actually inspected. Authored body half dimensions 28.65/25.8 m sit about 0.6 m inside the exact mapped rectangle; chamfers/recesses simplify its ring and projecting diamond fins/canopies intentionally extend beyond it. Entrance sides are documented but centered offsets, vestibule positions, widths and canopy extents are illustrative photo reconstructions, not surveyed. Separate ballroom/retail annexes, mall, road skywalk, fountains, Tower B and actual terrain/plaza grade remain outside this individual tower. Flat geographic capture certifies relative footprint and facing only. Actually inspected the final north-up placement image: exact magenta tower rectangle bounds the body with the stated minor inset; diamond fins project slightly outside and separately modeled canopies point east/right hotel and west/left office. The individual tower is registered separately from all annexes. Signed facing uses the architect description, not a rectangle-only guess; centered entrance/vestibule offsets remain explicitly approximate. This is relative placement review, with actual plaza grade unmeasured.
